name: Startale USD
oneLiner: USDSC is Startale's 1:1 wrapper around M0's $M on Soneium, backed by short-term U.S. Treasury bills with collateral attested on-chain by M0 Validators.
collateral: Short-term U.S. Treasury bills held in bankruptcy-remote SPVs via M0 Protocol's permissioned Minter infrastructure; M0 Validators independently attest collateral sufficiency on-chain before minting
pegMechanism: 1:1 wrapper around M (M0) token — USDSC is minted by wrapping M via the Soneium-native UsdscToken contract; underlying M is backed by T-bill collateral attested by M0 Validators; redemption unwinds the wrapper back to M

genius.notes: USDSC is a Soneium-native M0 extension; M0 infrastructure disclosures do not establish a Startale-specific GENIUS authorization or foreign-issuer exception.

sourcesChecked: OCC GENIUS Act proposed rule and public releases
Issuer disclosures and token documentation (usd.startale.com, startale.com/en/blog/usdsc-faq)
Public U.S. permitted-issuer, state-qualified, official-application, and foreign-exception materials
Web search for Startale USDSC GENIUS Act authorization June 2026
OCC digital asset licensing applications tracker
NCUA PPSI application and standards proposals
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: Startale and M0 issuer materials were found, but no token-specific public U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, or registered/comparable foreign-issuer exception source was located for USDSC. Startale Group remains Singapore-domiciled with no announced U.S. regulatory authorization intent.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

mintAuthority.summary: USDSC is an M0-backed extension on Soneium; extension wrapping routes through M0 extension infrastructure while base M issuance remains on the Ethereum MinterGateway.

controls.label: M0 MinterGateway backing rail
controls.capDescription: Base M issuance backing USDSC depends on approved minters, validator attestations, mint-delay review, and M0 collateral/debt checks.

routeChecks.attestorQuorum: M0 docs describe validator attestations before minting; this review did not enumerate the live validator threshold.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: MinterGateway minting is bounded by approved-Minter status, collateral/debt checks, and mint-delay review before MToken mint.
routeChecks.caps: Per-Minter capacity can be changed by M0 TTG governance, so the cap is protocol-governed rather than immutable.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: MinterGateway is confirmed immutable/non-proxy; cap governance remains with M0 TTG and Registrar governance.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295161: Blockscout confirms ContractName=MinterGateway, IsProxy=false (immutable, non-upgradeable). EIP-1967 admin and impl slots both zero. No external admin or module surface; cap governance rests with M0 TTG (POWER token holders).

controls.label: M0 SwapFacility extension router
controls.capDescription: SwapFacility routes approved M0 extensions 1:1 against M; it can mint extension balances through wrap flows but does not create base M supply.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: SwapFacility wraps approved M0 extensions 1:1 against M and does not create base M supply.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: Extension minting is bounded by available M-backed wrapper flow and base M supply.
routeChecks.caps: SwapFacility cap follows M supply and can be changed through the M0 governance/admin path rather than an immutable cap.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Soneium SwapFacility proxy owner is reviewed as a 2-of-3 EOA multisig; MinterGateway base supply remains under M0 governance.

controls.evidence: At Soneium block 24028800: SwapFacility at 0xB6807116b3B1B321a390594e31ECD6e0076f6278 confirmed TransparentUpgradeableProxy (code=3060 bytes, impl=0xc435b33c017da7ef313bf2d3132c99c7673a194b). EIP-1967 admin slot=0x0f38d8a5583f9316084e9c40737244870c565924 (ProxyAdmin). ProxyAdmin owner=0xdcf79C332cB3Fe9d39A830a5f8de7cE6b1BD6fD1, a 2/3 EOA multisig with 3 EOA owners (verified eth_getCode=0x for all three), no modules (getModules() empty), guard=0x0. ProxyAdmin code confirmed present (2724 bytes). No upgrade path accessible without 2/3 Safe signers.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295161: MinterGateway confirmed immutable (IsProxy=false). At Soneium block 24028800: SwapFacility confirmed TransparentUpgradeableProxy; ProxyAdmin=0x0f38d8a5...; ProxyAdmin owner=2/3 EOA multisig 0xdcf79c... (3 EOA owners, no modules, no guard). All controls fully characterized.

reserves.name: M token held by Startale USDSC
reserves.issuerOrObligor: M0 Protocol and its approved M0 issuer/SPV collateral path

reserveReview.rationale: Startale identifies USDSC as an M0 extension that wraps M. M0 documents extensions as 1:1 backed by eligible collateral and describes M collateral as typically U.S. Treasury bills held in SPVs with validator attestations. The direct reserve relationship is therefore retained as 100% M without duplicating M's underlying Treasury envelope.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Startale USDSC M0-extension relationship and M0 collateral documentation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unlinked direct reserve asset remains. The Startale-specific issuer, SPV account, and custody allocation are not separately disclosed in the reviewed sources.
